head_html:
<style>
  .demo-lead { margin: 0 0 16px; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.75; }
  .demo-panels { display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(190px,1fr)); gap:10px; margin:10px 0 24px; }
  .demo-panels article { background:var(--surface); border:1px solid var(--border); padding:15px 17px; border-radius:8px; }
  .demo-panels h3 { margin:0 0 6px; font-size:12px; color:var(--muted); }
  .demo-panels strong { font-size:23px; line-height:1.3; }
  .demo-feature { padding:16px 20px; border:1px solid var(--border); border-radius:8px; background:var(--surface); margin: 2px 0 22px; }
  .demo-feature h2 { font-size:15px; margin:0 0 10px; }
  .demo-feature svg { width:100%; max-width:640px; height:auto; }
  .demo-feature button { font:inherit; border:1px solid var(--border-strong); background:var(--surface-2); color:var(--text); padding:7px 12px; border-radius:6px; cursor:pointer; }
  .demo-feature output { margin-left:10px; font-weight:700; }
  .demo-last { margin:12px 0 0; padding:12px 16px; border-left:4px solid var(--accent); background:var(--accent-bg); }
</style>

tail_html:
<script>
(() => {
  const btn = document.getElementById('demo-click');
  const out = document.getElementById('demo-count');
  if (!btn || !out) return;
  let clicks = 0;
  btn.addEventListener('click', () => { clicks++; out.textContent = `${clicks}回`; });
})();
</script>
